description: Registry of object-detection dataset sources and split artifacts. No third-party dataset is bundled by this manifest.

datasets.name: Microsoft COCO 2017
datasets.license_summary: COCO annotations are CC BY 4.0. The COCO Consortium does not own the images; image use is subject to Flickr terms and image-specific rights.
use_restrictions: Review image-level rights and terms before use
Do not assume annotation licensing also licenses image files
Do not redistribute images unless their individual rights permit it
datasets.notes: Candidate only. No images or annotations have been downloaded, reviewed, or validated for this project.

datasets.name: LVIS
datasets.license_summary: LVIS annotations and underlying COCO images have separate provenance and rights considerations; verify the exact release terms and source-image permissions before use.
use_restrictions: Review the official terms for the exact release
Check image provenance and rights independently
Preserve category and federated-annotation semantics during conversion
datasets.annotation_format: LVIS JSON; conversion to COCO-style records requires a reviewed mapping
datasets.notes: Candidate only. Long-tail categories and federated annotations need special handling; no conversion or validation has been performed.

datasets.name: Objects365
datasets.release: official release; exact version to be selected
datasets.license_summary: The dataset page states academic-purpose availability. Annotations and website are CC BY 4.0; image copyright remains with original owners and image use follows Flickr terms.
use_restrictions: Academic-purpose restriction must be checked against the intended project use
Review original image terms and preserve annotation attribution
datasets.annotation_format: Objects365 JSON; conversion to COCO-style records requires a reviewed mapping
datasets.notes: Candidate only. Not approved for commercial use; no assets have been downloaded or validated.

datasets.name: BDD100K
datasets.release: official release; exact subset and version to be selected
datasets.license_summary: Dataset terms permit educational, research, and not-for-profit use. Commercial use is restricted to BDD/BAIR Commons members and affiliates, with commercial licensing handled by UC Berkeley.
use_restrictions: Do not use commercially without the required authorization
Preserve the full Regents license notice in permitted copies
Use only the object-detection subset after confirming its terms
datasets.annotation_format: BDD100K labels; conversion to COCO-style records requires a reviewed mapping
datasets.notes: Candidate only. Driving-scene domain differs from general indoor/outdoor accessibility scenes; no assets have been downloaded or validated.
